note: Pete 2026-11-07: robot outfit for the geese (player bots' Canada Goose bot, Tandemonium #611); look 'brass'.
outfit: a Victorian clockwork automaton suit: a riveted polished brass chest plate with a small round glass window showing turning gears, and a big wind-up key sticking out of the back; a brass collar ring around the base of the neck; copper shoulder caps with rivets; brass upper-arm and forearm plates with leather straps; brass mechanical mitten gauntlets with hinged knuckles; a dark leather waist section; brass thigh plates and domed copper knee caps; brass shin guards; heavy riveted brass boots; a small pressure gauge on the chest
style: Photorealistic 3D character render, soft studio lighting, real materials. The goose wears a fitted robot suit like armour over its body: every plate follows the goose's own body shape closely, with dark flexible joints at the shoulders, elbows, knees and waist so it could ride a bicycle. No weapons, no wings added, no cape, no jetpack. The goose keeps its own head exactly: black head and neck, white cheek patch, eyes and beak unchanged, not covered. The goose has NO tail.
